_: cluster -> digit, read by eye off clusters_*.png. null means the cluster is not a clean single glyph and is dropped whole: c11 and c26 are background with no glyph, c21 is a clipped zero, c25 and c29 each mix two digits. Tied to the exact harvest parameters that produced the numbering -- 8 recordings, --every 1.0, --k 30, kmeans seed 0. Re-run `cluster` and re-read the sheets if any of those change.
